channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump teased an Iran deal that didn't come, but markets soared. Here’s why it keeps happening
item.description: As oil reserves and munitions stockpiles reportedly dwindle, analysts wonder how much longer markets will pounce when the Trump admin. dangles an Iran deal.

item.title: Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era and many firms 'don't even know it'
item.description: The Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas couldn't have come at a better time, with AI agent hacks stacking up from Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI.

item.title: Senate Republicans narrowly confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general
item.description: Blanche won confirmation in a 50-49 vote, with Republican Senators Susan Collins and Lisa Murkowski opposing him. Senator Bill Cassidy was the deciding vote.

item.title: Cyclospora fears lead consumers to lose their appetite for salads
item.description: Traffic to salad chains has fallen as consumers avoid greens due to the ongoing cyclospora outbreaks across the U.S.

item.title: Inside the startup drone maker powering Ukraine's deep-strike campaign
item.description: Fire Point CEO Iryna Terekh says Ukraine has "learned the hard way" that military leverage is integral to to bringing diplomacy within reach.

item.title: AI and job losses: How the next automation wave will impact the workforce
item.description: Recent tech layoffs have raised alarms for workers. But multiple studies find that the wave driven by AI looks very different from past automation cycles.

item.title: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in an volatile market. It has to prove itself first
item.description: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.

item.title: How cleaning up space debris could grow to become a big business
item.description: As Earth’s orbit gets more crowded, companies are betting that cleaning up space junk could become a lucrative new business.

item.title: ‘SaaSpocalypse’ debate intensifies as software stocks swing wildly
item.description: This week saw massive moves in both directions for software stocks, as investors try to figure out which names are best insulated from artificial intelligence.

item.title: A record-breaking week for options powers S&P 500 surge; volatility gauge is near 2026 low
item.description: The broad market benchmark soared to records this week, benefiting from options activity and a calmer VIX.

item.title: Hollywood is cranking out billion-dollar movies again. 'Spider-Man' just joined the ranks
item.description: Box office analysts say the resurgence of billion-dollar releases bodes well for a film industry that's still chasing pre-Covid levels, even with higher prices.

item.title: Prediction markets take center stage in latest round of quarterly earnings reports
item.description: Recent quarterly reports from DraftKings, Flutter Entertainment and others offer a view into prediction markets businesses and their performance.

item.title: U.S. Senate passes short-term funding bill to avert federal shutdown before election
Formula One is lagging other sport stocks. Why analysts think it's poised to race ahead
item.description: As the sports sector remains resilient among consumers, analysts are predicting big gains for this racing league.

item.title: Here are three key takeaways from the disappointing July jobs report
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls in the U.S. unexpectedly declined in July, but so did the unemployment rate, leaving investors with mixed signals.

item.title: Trump administration to invest $3 billion in minerals projects to boost U.S. defense supply chains
item.description: The White House needs critical minerals to replenish weapons stockpiles depleted during the Iran conflict and reduce U.S. dependence on Chinese supply chains.

item.title: Burger King overtakes Wendy's as the nation's second-largest burger chain
item.description: Burger King is once again the second-largest burger chain in the U.S. by system-wide sales.

item.title: Falling long-term unemployment isn't good news, economists say — what it means for jobseekers
item.description: Unemployment appears to have fallen due to an exodus of workers from the labor force, which would be bad for household finances and the economy.

item.title: Trump revives effort to fire Fed's Lisa Cook
item.description: Trump aide Dan Scavino told Cook there is "sufficient reason to believe that you made false statements on one or more mortgage agreements."

item.title: Chesky says Airbnb will spend ‘a lot more’ on AI as earnings beat and stock surges 15%
item.description: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky wasn’t sure AI would help the company, but a year later, he says it’s the reason growth is back.

item.title: The unwind of Situational Awareness isn't the only reason the AI trade is back
item.description: The hedge fund's forced selling was a clearing event, but earnings are sustaining the AI trade

item.title: Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham breezes through Senate, heads to House
item.description: A measure to impose new sanctions on Russian oil purchasers easily cleared the Senate and heads to the House.

item.title: Top Democrat proposes killing tax breaks for overseas oil production
item.description: Gas prices in the U.S. averaged $4.06 per gallon on Thursday — a major source of voter discontent heading into November's midterm elections.

item.title: Gold bugs spend $180 million betting all's clear for metal as bond yields stall
item.description: Despite a 25% decline in gold from its high in January, proponents of the precious metal are storming into bullish call positions.

item.title: Trump says he will appeal to Supreme Court after lower court blocks White House ballroom
item.description: The appeals court placed its ruling on hold for 14 days to allow the Trump administration to appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court.

item.title: Rockstar Energy founder builds Celsius stake, wants to take over as CEO
item.description: Rockstar Energy founder Russ Savage told CNBC he now controls 12 million shares of Celsius Holdings, amounting to roughly 4.7% of the energy drink company.

item.title: U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls were projected to increase by 83,000 in July while the unemployment rate would hold steady at 4.2%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: Shares of this digital medical platform jumped more than 100% overnight. Here’s why
item.description: The company is seeing huge profitability potential and a larger addressable market as a result of AI search.

item.title: Airlines like Delta and United are selling cheaper business-class tickets with fewer perks. Here's how your credit card can help
item.description: These cheaper fares often lack amenities such as airport lounge access, but the right credit card can help you get them back.

item.title: Crypto’s infrastructure era arrives, with AI agents poised to reshape demand
item.description: Crypto companies are trying to build a second growth engine by turning agents into the next wave of users.
